meta.title: Build tag to exclude Cloud archiver providers
meta.body_summary: Add build tags to conditionally exclude cloud archiver providers (S3 and GCloud) to reduce binary size by ~24MB.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit build tag addition with binary size evidence; closed by author with no review or comments; likely self-rejection unobservable from dataset.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 172 changed lines across 12 files, this is a small build system change. As a binary size optimization PR, it was closed by the author without review; the small scope does not explain the non-merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review comments or feedback available; PR closed by author shortly after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce binary size by 24MB for builds that do not need cloud archiver providers.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author without external feedback; possible self-rejection or reprioritization.

core_change_summary.description: Added build tags `cloud_archiver` to conditionally compile cloud archiver providers (gcloud and s3store). Each archiver implementation now has `_on.go` and `_off.go` files with appropriate build constraints, and existing files stripped of cloud-specific code when tag is off.
change_trajectory: Single commit d02f98 introduces build-tag split for gcloud and s3store archiver providers with before/after binary size evidence.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with changes and binary size evidence, then closed shortly after without receiving any review or comment.
